scripts.build:web: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b apps/web/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:all: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b apps/web/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.db:reset: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && node scripts/reset-db.mjs && node apps/server/dist/db/migrate.js
